name: tests-half-hikari-user-field-evidence-and-contextual-de9c
instr:
Add immutable field evidence to factory users and contextual wrappers. Preserve existing behaviour.

UserImpl.evidence() returns UserEvidence with matching user_id. Observed username retains its value; global_name distinguishes explicit null from omission. Omitted flags are DEFAULTED, supplied zero flags OBSERVED. Field records reject mutation and evidence.fields rejects item assignment. Evidence survives payload mutation, mapping reordering and shallow model copying.

compare returns conflicts exposing field, left and right for different observed values, retaining both sources and sorting by field name without modifying inputs. prefer retains observed fields over later UNAVAILABLE fields and preserves fields absent from the later set; later EXPLICIT_NULL replaces an observed value. Different identities raise EvidenceIdentityError without modifying the earlier evidence. Cache reconciliation also rejects mismatched evidence identities and retains cached evidence and username.

Account evidence excludes TEAM, GUILD_MEMBER and INTERACTION sources. Member wrapping preserves nested account observations and their source. Factory Member fields distinguish omitted pending from supplied false, and omitted nick from explicit null while both nickname values remain None. Team membership_state and permissions observations use TEAM and team_id context. InteractionMember retains account and guild ownership, adds INTERACTION permissions and preserves permissions/display_name.
